project.name: custom
project.description: Local web UI for WingFoil-governed projects, served by a local server that drives the wingfoil CLI.

modules.name: server
modules.description: Local HTTP server and WingFoil CLI adapter (placeholder until initial-design)

modules.name: contracts
modules.description: JSON schemas of the consumed WingFoil CLI output (placeholder until initial-design)

technologies.name: WingFoil CLI
technologies.notes: pinned devDependency; also the CLI contract the UI consumes (support matrix 0.2.2, 0.3.1)

technologies.name: Playwright
technologies.notes: confirmed by adr-002: e2e on Chromium, Firefox, WebKit

technologies.name: Fastify
technologies.notes: adr-002: HTTP API and SSE, JSON Schema validation (Ajv), pino

technologies.name: Vite
technologies.notes: adr-002: dev server and static SPA build

technologies.name: TanStack Query
technologies.notes: adr-002: server state, invalidated by the event stream

technologies.name: Vitest
technologies.notes: adr-002: unit, component and contract tests

roles.name: approver
roles.description: Rules decisions and approves gates; a person, never an agent.

roles.name: facilitator
roles.description: Runs the workflows: captures, assesses, proposes and applies.

roles.name: product-owner
roles.description: Owns what the project captures and decides to do.

roles.name: architect
roles.description: Shapes the system: writes the tech-specs and the architecture decisions.

roles.name: developer
roles.description: Writes the code and its tests, and captures the bugs found.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Reviews the work of others before it is accepted.

roles.name: qa
roles.description: Checks a release before it is published and rehearses its publication.

roles.name: tech-lead
roles.description: Triages bugs and runs a release: its states, commit, tag and publication.
